offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures pool equipment such as pumps, filters, heaters, automation and control systems, sanitizers, cleaners and lighting for residential swimming pools. Sells mainly through distributors to pool builders, retailers and service professionals, who serve pool owners.

primary_products.value: pool pumps; pool filters; pool heaters and heat pumps; salt chlorine generators and sanitizers; robotic pool cleaners; pool automation and lighting

customer_segment.value: B2B: pool equipment distributors, pool builders, retailers and service professionals; B2C: residential pool owners buying replacement equipment and online

end_markets.value: residential swimming pools; pool construction; pool maintenance and renovation; light commercial pools

revenue_model.value: product sales: pool equipment sold to distributors, dealers, retailers and builders, including replacement and aftermarket parts

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: designs and makes pool equipment from purchased components and materials, sold to distributors and dealers; brand owner: markets branded pool equipment and some outsourced products to pool professionals

geography_served.value: global: North America is the largest market, also Europe, Australia and other international regions

specialization.value: related lines: pumps, filters, heaters, sanitizers, cleaners, automation and lighting for pools

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: independent pool equipment distributors and dealers, the main channel; third-party retail: big-box and specialty retailers; online: e-commerce sales of consumer-oriented products; direct sales: builders and some large accounts
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; third-party retail; online; direct sales

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: energy efficiency standards for pumps and heaters (US DOE, California), electrical safety, and chemical sanitizer rules (EPA)
